platform: Linux; no physical GPU; SwiftShader Vulkan compute; no renderer or capture
baseline_driver: Current wave-cost example added to baseline engine; same geometry, volumes and tick-indexed input as after.
scope: Same fixed physical input, sequential runs on the same software adapter; timing includes allocation and first-use compute. Not a hardware GPU or 144 FPS / 60 Hz claim. Small numerical differences can change CFL substep counts; CFL and original f64 residual tolerances are unchanged. Wall-timed GIFs have different physical input timing and are not the speed-ratio benchmark.
validation: Every tick checks phase volumes within 1e-7 cell and maximum post-projection divergence below 1e-3.
limits: Two-level preconditioning currently accelerates the cooperative path below 8192 pressure unknowns. At most 256 coarse aggregates; beyond that, GPU Jacobi preconditioning is retained. Distributed pressure and CPU/GPU round trips still need improvement. Preconditioner uploads increase explicit transfer volume.
